hook_text: Income plus costs is R900. So why is the profit only R300?
clip_script: Spring market in Vryheid! Ingredients: R89, R65 and R146. Total: R300. 120 vetkoek at R5: R600 income. Profit is income minus costs: R300, not R900! Three quarters of a 2 kg bag? Change to grams: 2 000 divided by 4 is 500, times 3 is 1 500 g. 5 litres into 250 ml cups? 5 000 divided by 250: 20 cups. 3 tarts for 4 helpers? Three quarters each!
visual_style: A busy school market stall with price tags, a till slip adding up, a scale showing grams and a jug pouring juice into cups.
mood: Cheerful and busy, like a market morning.
pacing: Quick sums on the till slip, then a slower pour and a fair cut of the tarts.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and plan the budget for your own class stall.
